title: Unit--Leray computation on K-injective complexes
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a scheme morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $I,J$ be K-injective cochain complexes of abelian étale sheaves on $X,Y$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions]. Let $j:f^{-1}I\to J$ be a chain map [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and $w:\Gamma_X I\to\Gamma_Y J$ a chain map with components the sectionwise inverse-image unit followed by $\Gamma_Y(j^i)$. Write $a_I:R\Gamma_X(QI)\cong Q(\Gamma_X I)$ and $a_J:R\Gamma_Y(QJ)\cong Q(\Gamma_Y J)$ for the inverse right-derived units on K-injectives, including the canonical quotient-to-derived comparisons [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Then $a_I^{\mathrm{hom}};Q(w);a_J^{\mathrm{inv}}$ equals $R\Gamma_X(\eta_f(QI));\lambda_f(D(f^{-1})(QI));R\Gamma_Y(c_I;Q(j))$, where $c_I:D(f^{-1})(QI)\cong Q(f^{-1}I)$ is the canonical factorization for exact inverse image, $\eta_f$ is the unit of the derived adjunction, and $\lambda_f$ the canonical Leray comparison. No augmentation, homotopy compatibility, or homology degree is assumed.

proof.text: On an arbitrary homotopy-category object K, expand the derived adjunction unit using Adjunction.derivedη_fac_app. Naturality moves the exact inverse-image factorization through Leray. The defining equation of rightDerivedFunctorCompIso and rightDerivedNatTrans_fac identify the composite derived unit followed by Leray with the derived unit of global sections on Y. Naturality of the global-sections unit at the underived adjunction unit completes unit_leray_h. Preservation of K-injectives by direct image is used by the canonical Leray construction; no K-injectivity of f_*J or adjunct of j is needed.

Naturality of the identification of global sections with terminal sections shows that Γ_X(η_M) followed by lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso at f^{-1}M equals globalSectionsUpperStarMap f M. Define the resulting chain map v:Γ_X I→Γ_Y(f^{-1}I). The component hypothesis hw and chain-map extensionality give w=v followed by Γ_Y(j). Apply the homotopy quotient and Qh to obtain the equality hquotient with Q(w).

Specialize unit_leray_h to the homotopy quotient of I. The quotient lifting comparisons are identities on representatives, identifying the homotopy and cochain exact inverse-image factorizations. Postcompose with RΓ_Y(Q(j)) and use naturality of the derived global-sections unit at j. Substitute hquotient. Expand rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso on I and J, whose units are invertible by K-injectivity, and cancel the unit on I. Functoriality and associativity give exactly the asserted equality.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleKInjective_unit_leray
    {X Y : Scheme.{uNatural}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (I : CochainComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}) ℤ)
    (J : CochainComplex (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective] [J.IsKInjective]
    (j : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I ⟶ J)
    (w : ((Sheaf.Γ X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I ⟶
        ((Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj J)
    (hw : ∀ i : ℤ, w.f i =
      globalSectionsUpperStarMap AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f (I.X i) ≫
        (Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}).map (j.f i)) :
    ((Sheaf.Γ X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}).rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso
        I).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map w ≫
      ((Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1}).rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso
        J).inv =
      (rightDerivedGlobalSections AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} X).map
          ((mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).unit.app
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)) ≫
        (rightDerivedLowerStarCompRightDerivedGlobalSectionsIso
          AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).hom.app
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapDerivedCategory.obj
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I)) ≫
        (rightDerivedGlobalSections AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} Y).map
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{uNatural + 1} f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app I ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map j)
